media-test.mpg is a synthetic, freely reproducible decoder fixture, generated by:

    ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x48:rate=25:duration=0.48 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=44100:duration=0.48 -c:v mpeg1video -g 6 -bf 2 -b:v 200k -c:a mp2 -b:a 128k -ac 2 -f mpeg media-test.mpg

It contains no game artwork or recordings. Running the engine/tests does not
require FFmpeg; it was used only to create this MPEG-1/MP2 test input.
